description: CSV data browsing and aggregation TUI with grouping, fuzzy search, and help page

tasks.description: Load /bench/data/employees.csv, use Fuzzy mode to search for EMP-5000, view the complete content of this entry.
Load /bench/data/employees.csv, use SQL-Like mode to run select where age > 62, display row count.
Load /bench/data/employees.csv, use SQL mode to run select * from df where age=65 and score > 90 and score < 92 and salary > 10000, display complete filtered content.

Load /bench/data/employees.csv, use Analysis Tools to view salary distribution; display p-value when distribution type is Uniform with three significant figures, Shapiro-Wilk test p-value with three significant figures, coefficient of variation (CV) and Kurtosis each with three significant figures.

Load /bench/data/employees.csv, use Analysis Tools to view Descriptive Statistics for score; display Mean, Std, Min, Max, 25th percentile, 50th percentile (median), 75th percentile, each with two decimal places.
Load /bench/data/employees.csv, use Analysis Tools to view correlation matrix for age, salary, score; display Pearson Correlation Coefficient between each pair of variables with two decimal places.
Load /bench/data/employees.csv, use Sort to sort all records by salary descending; display complete information for at least the top 5 people by salary.

Load /bench/data/employees.csv, use Sort to sort by age and score (age first, then score when age is equal), both descending; display complete information for at least the top 5 people with highest score among entries with the largest age.
Load /bench/data/employees.csv, use Filter to add conditions filtering records where score = 91.88 OR email contains 'oza@'; display complete information for matching records.
Load /bench/data/employees.csv, use Filter to add condition country = 'UK', then use Sort to sort those records by score ascending; display complete information for at least the top five.

Load /bench/data/employees.csv, use Filter to add condition full_name contains 'Henry', then use Sort to sort by score ascending, then export results to /bench/data/Henry.csv with CSV header, comma-separated.
